parse.title: I
parse.text:
Translingual

Etymology 1

Letter

  1. The ninth letter of the basic modern Latin alphabet.

Letter

  1. The upper case of the dotless i (“ı”), used in the alphabets of several Turkic languages written in the Latin script.
See also

Symbol

  1. (chemistry) Chemical element symbol for iodine.
  2. (physics) Isotopic spin.
  3. (license plate codes) Italy
  4. (physics, electronics) Electrical current.
  5. (physics, kinematics) moment of inertia.
  7. January.
  8. (biochemistry) IUPAC 1-letter abbreviation for isoleucine.
  9. (mathematics, linear algebra) identity matrix.
  10. (mathematical analysis, topology) the (closed) unit interval; [0, 1].
  11. (inorganic chemistry) Specifying an oxidation state of 1
  12. (music) major tonic triad.
  13. (linguistics) A wildcard for a front vowel or a high vowel.
  14. (actuarial notation) arithmetically increasing payments.
  15. (clothing) Bra cup size.
  16. The symbol in bases higher than eighteen for the number expressed as 18 in decimal.

Etymology 2

Numeral

  2. Cardinal number one.
    • 2021 June 28, Homero De la Fuente, “NCAA takes big step toward allowing athletes to profit from name, image or likeness”, in CNN‎[1] (in English):
